body: The community repository for the Draw Things app.
plain_description: **Build and run image generation with Draw Things.** The repository provides code for the app’s image models, samplers, and training, plus tools to generate images locally or host a server.
technical_description: Community repository for public-facing code used by the Draw Things app. It includes implementations of image generation models, samplers, data models, and training, along with a local inference and LoRA training CLI and a self-hosted gRPC server CLI. The README documents building and running these tools on macOS and CUDA-capable Linux, including Docker deployment for the server.
title: Draw Things Community
